ios.desc:
Margins is a beautifully designed app for people who love books.

- App of the Day in 20+ countries
- 4.9 rating (40,000+ reviews)
- Featured in USA Today, BookRiot, and more

TRACK YOUR READING
 - Log books, series, authors, recommendations, and more
- Track Strava-style goals, stats, and streaks
- Curate lists of books you care about

SEARCH BOOKS BY VIBES
- Search books by mood, plot, setting, vibe, and more
- Try things like “books like 1920s Paris,” “thriller with a love triangle,” or “indie romantasy”
- You can even turn images from Pinterest or your camera roll into book recommendations

BLOCK DISTRACTING APPS
- Block social media, notifications, and other apps while you read
- Use meditation reading timer for soothing rain sounds

CHOOSE YOUR COVERS
- Pick the cover that matches your version of the book
- Curate covers to fit your aesthetic
- Sort your library by color

CUSTOMIZE YOUR PROFILE
- Turn your picture into a sketched portrait you’d see in a book
- Show off your favorite books

SEE WHAT FRIENDS ARE READING
- Find and follow other book lovers
- See what they’re reading in Stories
- Enjoy gorgeous, hand-illustrated monthly recaps

INVITE YOUR BOOK CLUB
- Schedule gatherings
- Suggest and vote on books
- Log your club’s history

LEAVE GOODREADS FOR GOOD
- Import from Goodreads, StoryGraph, and Fable
- Half-star ratings
- Support a small, indie team

WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING

“LOVE this app! so easy to import data from goodreads. it excels where others fail. like letterboxd for books. Really glad there’s finally a good book app out there, i’ve been waiting for something like this!” — scruffythejanitor01

“I love the UI of this app, easy to use and aesthetically pleasing. Also, I've been struggling getting back into reading and the screentime feature has helped me loads. I haven't been able to read this much since 4 years ago. Thank you Margins” — mitakaluvr

“The search by vibes is so cool. I am a WWII buff, but this search popped up a two-book WWII saga I had never even heard of, much less read. It ended up being my top read of 2025.” —Michigancolt

FREE TO USE
Almost all features are free to use. An optional subscription unlocks premium features and priority support. 

FOLLOW US
Instagram: @readwithmargins 
TikTok: @margins
